Description: Rust. 5 real Open Baltimore datasets bundled (NIBRS crime 276k, 311 2025 931k, vacant notices 11k, liquor 31k, CitiWatch 861) plus fetch script. Full multi-stage concurrency: threaded ingest, parallel match/aggregate/analyze, deterministic across thread counts. 5/5 cross-dataset questions, all answered with ASCII, HTML, JSON and a web server. 28 tests, clippy clean, 0.9 s run. Top of class.

Go. 4 real datasets bundled (crime, 311, liquor, vacant GeoJSON). Chunked parallel CSV decode, sharded map-reduce join, parallel analysis strategies, race-clean. 5/5 cross-dataset questions incl. a two-hop council-district scorecard; ASCII + HTML + token-protected web UI verified. 3.3 s run. Only nit: prebuilt .app would not launch from sandbox.

Go. 3 real datasets bundled (311 2026 943k, NIBRS 278k, liquor 31k). Worker-pool parse, fan-out/fan-in block-level join, 5 analyses run concurrently, race-clean on full data. 5/5 cross-dataset questions with ASCII and HTML charts; fresh run reproduces shipped report byte for byte. 15 tests. 1.6 s run.

Go, LATE. 2 real datasets (NIBRS + 311) but only a one-week June 2025 excerpt (1,137 crimes / 1,540 requests). Full concurrency: worker pools per dataset, 5 questions run as goroutines, streaming with column projection, 14 tests. 5/5 cross-dataset questions with named stakeholders and dual histograms. Every README number reproduced. Lost points only on dataset count and data scale.

Go. 4 datasets fetched via `make fetch` (crime, 311, liquor, vacants) but nothing bundled; documented `make demo` and the submitted report run on a synthetic generator in exact Open Baltimore schemas. Full concurrency, 11 packages, 25 tests, race-clean. 5/5 cross-dataset questions; on real data 3 answered well, Q2 unavailable (license layer had no coordinates), Q5 half-degenerate.

Go. 2 real datasets (NIBRS 278k, 311 931k) fetched by the README's curl commands, not bundled. Full concurrency with compare mode proving sequential == concurrent (4.2x speedup), race-clean, tests in every package. 5/5 cross-dataset questions with mix-adjusted controls and ASCII charts. 2.4 s run. Lost points on dataset count and bundling.

Go. 2 real datasets bundled (NIBRS 54k, vacant notices 11k). README carries leftover AI-assistant notes.

Full concurrency, race-clean, 950 MB processed in 2 s at 830 MB RSS. 5 questions, 3 cross-dataset; Q4/Q5 are side-by-side single-dataset views. ASCII charts, named stakeholders.

Go. 2 real datasets fetched live at runtime (20k most-recent 311, 11.5k vacants), nothing bundled. Full concurrency: parallel fetch, bounded semaphore pool, parallel analytics. 5/5 cross-dataset questions (Pearson by category, ZIP targeting); tables + ASCII. No unit tests, stakeholders implied not named. go.mod pins Go 1.27.2.

Go. Declares 2 real datasets but ships none; run.sh silently generates synthetic data in the real schema. Engine itself is excellent: full worker-pool concurrency, 15/15 architecture, tests, race-clean, verified by grader on real files. 5/5 cross-dataset questions with named stakeholders and ASCII charts. Flat single package, no tests. 1.8 s run.

Clean multi-package layout, 7 tests.
